whenToUse: Right-click or long-press actions on files, kanban cards, tree nodes and table rows.
Power-user shortcuts that mirror an existing ⋯ menu (same MenuEntry[] data).
avoidWhen: The only way to reach an action — always also offer a visible ⋯ Dropdown Menu.
a11y: Opens with Shift+F10 / the Menu key; items follow the menu pattern.
Destructive items are labelled clearly and confirmed.
